operator_io_quirks: All identifiers are mixed-case ("Campuses","csu_fees","TotalEnrollment_AY","FTE_AY"); must double-quote with original spelling.
Table names differ only by case-ish (Campuses vs csu_fees); column lookup must be case-insensitive but preserve spelling.
All columns declared NOT NULL=0 (nullable) yet null_rate=0.0 everywhere; TS will not enforce NOT NULL, so NULLs may appear and insert fine.
faculty has NO primary key (pk=[]); sample_fresh_primary_keys must handle empty PK (no dedup) without crashing.
Composite PKs: degrees(Year,Campus), discipline_enrollments(Campus,Discipline), enrollments(Campus,Year) -> composite-PK member max_l0=30 path.
csu_fees.Campus is both PK and FK to Campuses.Id (single-column PK that is also FK); PK dedup and FK fill interact.
All FKs point to Campuses.Id (parent_exists true, unique parent); no dangling/self FKs here.
discipline_enrollments.Year has distinct=1 (all 2004) -> Number sampler list range collapses; near-constant column.
csu_fees.Year distinct=2 (1996,2003) -> tiny element set, list-range quirk (min(el), full-range max) will dominate.
faculty.Faculty is REAL storage 'real' but samples look like '357.1' -> Number float path, +-0.01/0.02 perturbation.
Campuses.Year samples include 1887,1965,2002 (wide, non-contiguous) -> Number full-range draws plausible but list range narrow.
Small tables (23..1113 rows) -> no max_rows_per_table sampling triggered; original_values fully read.
operator_ts_expectations: All columns dispatch to Number fuzzer (INTEGER/REAL); no String/Date/Time/Bool fuzzers used despite TEXT columns? No: Campus/Location/County are TEXT -> String fuzzer.
String fuzzer on Campus/Location/County: random a-zA-Z0-9() strings + contaminate, so campus names become gibberish -> likely FN on name-equality/join predicates.
Number fuzzer on Id/Campus/Year: full-range uniform + perturbation; Year values like 1887..2004 plausible but Id/Campus random ints may exceed 1..23 -> FK/join misses.

FK fill draws Campus from Campuses.Id final values, so joins on Campus=Id stay consistent; but Year joins across tables (enrollments.Year vs degrees.Year) are NOT FK-linked -> random Year values break cross-table year joins (FP/FN).
discipline_enrollments.Year constant 2004 in original; TS randomizes it -> queries filtering Year=2004 may return empty (FN) or spurious rows.
csu_fees.Year only 1996/2003; TS list-range quirk gives near-full-range ints -> predicates on fee year rarely match (FN).
Composite PK dedup keeps first occurrence; with random ints collisions rare -> sizes near requested, but enrollments(Campus,Year) may lose rows.
faculty has no PK -> no dedup, duplicate (Campus,Year) rows possible -> COUNT/aggregate queries get inflated counts (FP).
Number perturbation (+-1,+-2) on small Id/Campus values can push to 0 or negative -> FK values may not match parent (but FK drawn from parent so ok); non-FK ints go out of domain.
String contaminate (prefix/suffix/drop char) makes exact-match on Campus/Location/County fail -> FN on equality, FP on LIKE.
Empty literal pool for most columns (few train SQL) -> p=0.2 fresh draws dominate; max_l0 cap reuses values -> ties/duplicates appear (FP on DISTINCT/COUNT).
REAL Faculty perturbed by +-0.01/0.02 -> float equality predicates fail (FN).
